To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
copper oxide nanoparticles synthesized using plant extracts can be used for wood protection against decay fungi and termite.
copper oxide nanoparticle and plant extracts formulation has potential to act as a wood protectant.

copper oxide nanoparticles synthesized using plant extracts have the potential to replace the currently used wood preservative formulations that are based on chemical preservatives and that are known to be toxic to the environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an ecofriendly wood protection system using metal nanoparticles and plant extract.
the synthesis of metal nanoparticles using plant extracts and their utilization for wood protection.
the synthesis and characterization of metal nanoparticles, and the development of a novel wood protection system using metal nanoparticles and plant extract.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is the first study to report the synthesis of copper oxide nanoparticles using the extracts of Neem, Pongamia, Lantana and orange peel and their application in the field of wood science.
copper oxide nanoparticles synthesized using plant extracts can be utilized as a wood preservative and is an effective and ecofriendly alternative for chemical preservatives.
the use of plant extracts and nanoparticles in wood preservation is a promising and effective approach to develop an eco-friendly and cost-effective wood preservative formulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the metal nanoparticle formulation is an environmentally friendly wood protectant that can replace the current chemical wood preservatives.

the metal nanoparticles are synthesised using plant extract which has wood preservative property and the synergistic effect of the intrinsic property and the biocidal effect of metal nanoparticles is utilized for wood protection.
the plant extract mediated synthesis of metal nanoparticle is a new and ecofriendly method for wood protection.

plant extracts can be used as stabilizing agents for metal nanoparticles.
the use of plant extracts as reducing agents in synthesis of metal nanoparticles can be a new and promising approach for wood protection.
the plant extracts and copper oxide nanoparticles can be used together as wood preservatives in an ecofriendly way.
